body: Can you share the code you're trying to execute?
And which task is not being executed? I can only see the setup hook on your code, and it runs ok. Maybe you could come up with an example app to reproduce it?
Alright I think I can reproduce it, going to see what's happening.
Okey in another computer it seems to be happening with just 2 sidecars executing... So not sure what is happening in the background. Maybe a tokio runtime configuration thing?

The `hi` is printed if I force kill one of the sidecar processes, so I think this is some kind of limitation with the number of spawned tasks on `tokio`. There's not much I can do, except reduce the number of tasks spawned by the sidecar (currently 3 for each command).
Isn't there some configuration that can remove that limitation for tokio?
I'll push a PR that reduces the spawn count from 3 to 1 on each sidecar. I don't see an alternative solution :/
Hmm we could use this, but I'm not sure it's a good idea to increase the default value: https://docs.rs/tokio/1.7.1/tokio/runtime/struct.Builder.html#method.worker_threads
I understand... It does the trick though, I'm able to create 3 sidecars and spawn more things :)
#2044 will also fix it for your use case.

Yeap just saw it, thanks!

Your real-time support is really appreciated.
